pcy.text: Latulla rose to prominence by expelling the master of her house and taking over his faction, and was placed in command of the Prophecy War, when the Keldons launched their invasion of Jamuraa.
The Keldons raided the Jamuraan coast, took hostages and settled, while the Kipamu League was unable to resist, and Latulla took the captive Kipamu officer Haddad as her slave.
She returned to Keld to push the warlords to awaken the Witch Kings, but Gorsha defeated her in ritual combat at the Keldon Necropolis and exiled her and her supporters.
Her counterattack against the Kipamu League failed, and pinned under a war barge, she was decapitated by Barrin, whom she had mistaken for a slave.
